description: PROJECT CROSSBOW: RES-CC preliminary testing grid data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Lucas Pons (ETRA). Project CROSSBOW is an EU funded project with grant agreement Nº 773430 in the topic LCE-04-2017. This dataset corresponds to the regional grid model used as input for the tests done for RES-CC products during the preliminary demostration phase. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
